notes: Two panel pages were loading a file that was never included in the download, so a piece of each quietly did nothing. The Panel Editor's Spacing tab and the original Gauge theme both ask the same component which shape a panel is…

The build now refuses to ship a page that loads a file the download does not contain. The existing check only followed the app's own code and could not see a page's scripts and stylesheets, which is how the above went unnoticed through…

Filling in the panel capability sheet now changes the app directly. Until now the sheet wrote its answers to a file nothing read, and someone had to copy them into the code by hand for anything to happen. The app reads that file itself…
The lowest-tier dropdown on that sheet now does something. It used to record a choice nothing acted on; a setting set above your plan is shown locked rather than simply appearing.
Corner radius was a working panel setting that was missing from the capability sheet entirely. It is on the list now, so it cannot be dropped by accident.
